content: Prisma has no built-in FOR UPDATE/SKIP LOCKED — must issue SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via tagged-template  on the transaction client inside an interactive  callback, then read, increment, update within the same transaction (official functional test shows 12 concurrent increments ending correct).  supports {timeout, maxWait}. For gapless sequential business numbers PostgreSQL docs state nextval/setval never roll back, so plain sequences leave gaps — for gapless assignment use exclusive locking of a counter table (UPDATE ... RETURNING on a singleton row, no index for HOT updates, keep transactions short) or per-month/per-type counter rows locked FOR UPDATE.
